headline: CIN @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.84 at PHI 4.68, with a projected total of 9.52. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved +1.28 runs while PHI moved -0.50, changing the projected margin by +1.78 runs. The projected total climbed +0.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.8%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andrew Painter has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 4.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Elly De La Cruz, Spencer Steer, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Will Benson, Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
